claude_proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item can be toggled to emit or extinguish green Dim Light while held, and no current effect atom models light emission.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can cause it to emit green Dim Light out to 10 feet ... or you can extinguish the light"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: item_form_gating_on_current_form
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's passive, reaction, and ranged-weapon riders are available only in specific current forms, but the surface cannot persist item form state or gate mechanics by that state.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "turning it into a 6-inch rod ... or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff" and "Quarterstaff Form Only" / "Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: return_to_hand_after_ranged_attack
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The quarterstaff-form ranged rider includes an immediate return-to-hand effect after a ranged attack, which is not modeled by existing atoms.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand."
